content_data.meeting_title: Regional Biosecurity Data Integration Initiative - Technical Working Group
agenda_items: Review of current mobile data collection protocols for pathogen surveillance
Update on ethical guidelines for genomic data handling in a mobile-first context
key_decisions: Prioritize the development of a secure API for regional data exchange over direct database access.
Adopt FHIR-based data standards for all new mobile data collection applications within the next 3 months.
attendees: Dr. Omar Khan, Research Program Manager (Regional Initiatives)
Dr. Samuel Lee, Data Security Specialist (Cybersecurity)
Dr. Lena Petrova, Principal Investigator (AI & Machine Learning)
